prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-12
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): b7f6c8e6b6602c87
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback divider-64 send 0xa5 fails with TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5, i.e. RX saw idle 0xff instead of data. Root cause is TX reset send_pattern <= ~1 (LSB 0 break) instead of ~0 idle-high, driving ser_tx low through reset and causing a false start that fills RX with 0xff before real data. Provenance picosoc/picosoc.v:190 simpleuart instance and picosoc/simpleuart.v:20 module pins this to TX reset logic.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash b7f6c8e6b6602c87 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
